rows.grounds: past participle of śiṣ, neuter nominative singular
compound of krīḍana and ādi, indeclinable list marker
compound of caṇḍikāvat and smṛta, neuter nominative singular

items.question: What do the wise remember as caṇḍikā-like among the remaining all game-etc?
items.inference: The wise remember the remaining all game-etc as caṇḍikā-like.
items.plain_english: The wise remember all the remaining game and so forth as caṇḍikā-like.
